# AgentR

> AgentR is an AI hiring assistant that reads every job application in full, checks what candidates claim against the public record, and runs structured interviews scored against a rubric written before anyone applied. The hiring team receives a ranked shortlist with the evidence attached. Nobody is auto-rejected; every decision stays with a human.

AgentR is built by Vibencode Private Limited (Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, India) and is in private beta. Contact: hello@agentr.global.

## Docs

- [Machine-readable overview](https://agentr.global/ai/): the full product summary written for language models — what it is, how it works, what it will not do, pricing, and FAQs
- [Homepage in markdown](https://agentr.global/index.md): the landing page's content as plain markdown
- [Pricing](https://agentr.global/pricing/): credit-based billing — one balance drawn down by AI work, no seats, no per-user fees; private beta starts with $100 in credits
- [Smarter Screening](https://agentr.global/smarter-screening/): every application read and scored against your criteria
- [Better Shortlisting](https://agentr.global/better-shortlisting/): ranking on twenty signals with the evidence behind each one
- [Faster Scheduling](https://agentr.global/faster-scheduling/): no calendars or slots — one link, valid fourteen hours
- [Fairer Interviews](https://agentr.global/fairer-interviews/): questions built from the role, answers scored against a written rubric
- [Resume Verification](https://agentr.global/resume-verification/): claims checked in context against the public record, six verdict classes
- [AI Cheating Prevention](https://agentr.global/ai-cheating-prevention/): interview integrity for the copilot era, including the AgentR Guard desktop app
- [Volume Screening](https://agentr.global/volume-screening/): the same rubric for applicant one and applicant a thousand
- [Pre-BGV Filter](https://agentr.global/pre-bgv-filter/): a consistency check before formal background-verification spend
- [For candidates](https://agentr.global/for-candidates/): what happens to an application, what is recorded, what is never done
- [AI transparency notice](https://agentr.global/candidate-privacy/): how AI is used on candidate data, in plain language
